thread:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — PR #482 (https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pull/482) tweaks microcopy in SDK examples and proposes renaming 'endpoint' -> 'route' across user-facing docs. Need editorial sign-off and a quick search/replace audit. Example snippet:
```js
// old
fetch('/v1/endpoint/generate')
// proposed
fetch('/v1/route/generate')
```
Happy to run a codemod if we agree on scope.

Samir Patel: Quick thought — we use 'endpoint' in the API reference and some product pages. Are we comfortable with a global replace or do we limit scope?

Lena Ortiz: I prefer 'route' for clarity given our routing policies. +1 for docs and examples. We should be careful about blog posts & changelogs though.

Maria Chen: Good point. Proposal: change only in docs/ and sdk/ examples/source files for now. Leave blog/ and RELEASE_NOTES.md for separate follow-ups. I'll build a codemod that targets markdown (.md/.mdx) and code samples (.js/.py).

Alex Kim: Important: do NOT rename actual SDK method names yet. e.g., `client.createEndpoint()` stays the same. This is a docs wording change only. Add a note in the breaking-changes section so it's explicit.

Samir Patel: Agreed. Also let's standardize casing guidance: `camelCase` for JS snippets and `snake_case` for Python. Add to style guide so examples are consistent.

Lena Ortiz: I've pushed a small PR to the glossary: add entry 'route — user-facing API path (preferred term over endpoint)'. Can reviewers @Samir @Alex take a look?

docs-bot: CI check: docs build succeeded for PR #482 :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: Thanks. @Samir can you run a grep across the repo for 'endpoint' and paste the top hits so we can prioritize? I'll prep the codemod once we lock scope.

Samir Patel: Running now... top hits (shortlist):
- docs/reference/auth.md: "token endpoint"
- sdk/js/examples/chat.md: several examples using `/v1/endpoint/generate`
- docs/faq/perf.md: mentions "endpoint routing" in a sentence
I'll put a fuller list in the PR comments.

Lena Ortiz: :thumbsup: I can take blog/ and faq scanning off Maria's plate — will flag anything that needs separate treatment.

Alex Kim: I'll update the style guide section 'Naming & casing' with the camel/snake rules and add concrete snippet examples for both languages.

Maria Chen: Plan recap:
- Samir: run a repo scan + post full file list by EOD.
- Lena: scan blog/ and docs/faq for contextual uses and flag items to exclude.
- Alex: update style guide and add casing examples.
- Maria: run codemod and open PR #486 for the rename in docs/ and sdk/examples.
If no objections by EOD we'll merge tomorrow morning. :shipit:

Samir Patel: One more ask — notify the translations/i18n team to hold off automated updates until we finalize english source text.

Lena Ortiz: I'll ping @i18n-team.

docs-bot: Reminder: PR #482 waiting on reviewers: Samir Patel, Alex Kim, Lena Ortiz.

Alex Kim: LGTM once the style guide update lands. :eyes:

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — will follow up with PR links and the codemod log when ready.
